assumptions: The isolated source archiver and API dispatch path are deployed, with no copy message queued or running.
Lambda has reserved but not provisioned concurrency, so zero requests and zero duration cost zero compute.
The queue and dead-letter queue contain no messages and use SQS-managed encryption.
The archiver reuses the API image repository, versioned geodata bucket, and existing data KMS key.
One function-only database credential and two standard CloudWatch alarms remain allocated.
Retained copies are billed at the base plan's linear S3 rate; source requests, transfer, Lambda duration, Data API calls, KMS calls, logs, and database wake time are usage-dependent.
The no-egress GIS worker and its private endpoints remain separate activation-only stacks for PMTiles conversion and are absent while inactive.

items.description: Dedicated function-only source archiver database credential
Request-driven archiver with no provisioned concurrency
